gameplan.summary: Bully early with Q-auto-W, scale into a frontline tank. Win through sustained fights and Villain execution.
gameplan.win_condition: Split push and force 1v1s early. Teamfight as frontline tank with Judgment peel.
gameplan.early_game: Q into auto with Decisive Strike. Max Q for max slow and silence duration.
gameplan.positioning: Frontline in teamfights. Use W to reduce damage. Save Q for catching key targets.

darius.tips: Never let him stack bleed to 5. Short trades only — Q in and out. Buy Steelcaps + Stridebreaker rush.
darius.power_shift: He wins extended trades all game. Win through split pushing when he's not nearby.

teemo.tips: His blind negates your Q auto. Rush MR item. Don't chase into his mushrooms. Freeze lane.
teemo.power_shift: He kites you forever. Win by roaming and taking objectives while he pushes.

malphite.tips: Long trade wins — Judgment melts him. Don't let him poke you down pre-6. Take Ignite.
malphite.power_shift: Even. Both are frontlines. Win via Stridebreaker to prevent him kiting.

vayne.tips: She shreds tanks with W passive. Pressure early before she scales. Force fights before 3 items.
vayne.power_shift: She wins 1v1 at 2+ items. Win through teamfights where her DPS is split.

nasus.tips: Deny his farm early with Q poke. Don't let him reach 300 stacks. Pressure him off minions constantly.
nasus.power_shift: He outscales at 400+ stacks. Win the game before 25 minutes.
